messages:
Priya (AcmeOps): Hey team — after we migrated our org to SAML SSO this morning, our compliance team lost ability to view audit logs in Console and the API returns 403. We need retention exports for last quarter urgently. :grimacing:
Alex W (Support): sorry you're hitting that, Priya. Can you paste the exact curl you ran and the error body?
Priya (AcmeOps): sure — here's the simplified repro:
```
TOKEN=ey... (redacted)
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.com/v1/audit/logs?org=acme-corp&start=2025-10-01"
```
Response: 403 Forbidden
{
  "error": "forbidden",
  "code": "audit.logs.read_denied",
  "message": "missing entitlement: audit_log.read or retention_entitlement"
}
Alex W (Support): thanks. two quick checks: 1) is this user principal mapped to an org role that previously had audit access? 2) did you migrate group-to-role mappings in the IdP?
Priya (AcmeOps): we did group mapping but migrated via copy of old SAML app. Our IdP admin says claims look the same.
sso-bot: Incoming SAML assertion detected for user priya@acme.com — mapped groups: [compliance, engineers] — mapped attributes: {email: priya@acme.com, roles: [member]}
Ida S (SRE): quick hypothesis: the console-level retention entitlement is granted via an org-level flag (retention_entitlement) that used to be set on the legacy profile. SAML migration reset some account attributes if the IdP assertion doesn't include the custom org attributes.
Marcus (Eng): also check token scopes. If you're using an API key created pre-migration it should keep scopes, but session tokens minted via SSO might be missing the audit scope. Can you run the token introspect? Example:
```
curl -X POST https://auth.redwood.com/introspect -d "token=$TOKEN"
```
Introspect result should include: scopes: ["auditlog.read","audit:export"], entitlements: ["retention:compliance"]
Priya (AcmeOps): introspect shows scopes: ["read:logs"] and entitlements: [] — aha.
Alex W (Support): that confirms it. two paths: fast workaround — we can grant a temporary org-level entitlement so your compliance team can export retention data; long-term fix — have IdP include the custom attribute or add a role mapping rule. I can provision the temporary grant if you confirm the admin contact.
Priya (AcmeOps): yes please. compliance@acme.com is the admin contact. We need exports from 2025-10-01 to 2025-12-31.
Olivia (CS): looping in eng for a quick safety check before we change entitlements. @Marcus can you take a look?
Marcus (Eng): jumping in. Before we grant anything, we need to ensure the retention export doesn't contain more data than requested and that audit export service is healthy. Running a quick health check against the export worker pool.
Marcus (Eng): export workers healthy, queue depth normal. I approve a temporary entitlement grant for one week with audited change. Please record the request and include a ticket.
Alex W (Support): creating internal ticket INC-2026-4321, scope: temporary retention_entitlement for org acme-corp, duration: 7d, reason: compliance export. Adding Ida and Marcus as approvers.
Alex W (Support): done. I ran the support action and added entitlement: retention:compliance to org acme-corp and the users in the compliance group. Please retry the API. :white_check_mark:
Priya (AcmeOps): re-ran same curl — now 200 OK and stream begins. Thank you!! :relieved:
Priya (AcmeOps): small follow-up: what do we change on our IdP so this doesn't happen again?
Ida S (SRE): ask your IdP admin to add a persistent custom attribute to the SAML assertion. Two safe options we recommend: 1) include a claim redwood:entitlements as a JSON string like `["retention:compliance","auditlog.read"]`, or 2) map your existing group claim to the Redwood role mapping (console: Settings → SSO → Attribute mapping). Right now your assertion only lists groups but our mapping needs either a role or explicit entitlements.
Marcus (Eng): to be explicit, the SAML attribute name we read is `redwood_attributes` (or `custom:roles` depending on IdP). If you can't change the assertion quickly, keep using org-level support grants but plan to add the attribute — it's required for long-term automated permissions.
Priya (AcmeOps): noted. I sent a ticket to our IdP team to add `redwood:entitlements`. We'll test next week after they update.
Alex W (Support): one more note — we removed the temporary grant and logged the change once you confirmed exports complete. If you need the export again, we can re-run or we can provide an export bundle via secure link.
Priya (AcmeOps): exports completed and downloaded. You can close INC-2026-4321. Really appreciate the fast turnaround. :heart:
Olivia (CS): closing on our side. I've added a short runbook to the ticket for customers migrating to SAML that covers the attribute names and a checklist. We'll push to docs so this is easier next time.
Priya (AcmeOps): thanks all — will follow up after IdP change to confirm permanent fix.
Alex W (Support): thanks Priya — marking resolved for now, reopen if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
